import statistics as st, math, json
vals = {
2017: 327990949917.96,

}
b = {y: v*1e-9 for y,v in vals.items()}
years=sorted(b)
levels=[b[y] for y in years]
changes=[b[y]-b[y-1] for y in years[1:]]
print('billions_by_fy=', json.dumps({y: round(b[y],3) for y in years}, sort_keys=True))
print('changes=', [round(x,3) for x in changes])
print('level_mean=', round(st.mean(levels),3))
print('level_median=', round(st.median(levels),3))
print('last_print_persistence_2025=', round(b[2025],3))
print('trailing3_mean_2023_2025=', round(st.mean([b[2023],b[2024],b[2025]]),3))
print('change_mean_2018_2025=', round(st.mean(changes),3))
print('change_median=', round(st.median(changes),3))
print('change_sample_std_sigma=', round(st.stdev(changes),3))
print('level_sample_std=', round(st.stdev(levels),3))
print('p10_p90_levels_approx_sorted=', [round(x,3) for x in sorted(levels)])
# walk-forward MAE for one-step forecasts for years 2020-2025 using prior data only: persistence, trailing3 when available, mean change
for model in ['persistence','trailing3','mean_change']:
    errs=[]
    forecasts=[]
    for y in range(2020,2026):
        hist=[b[t] for t in range(2017,y)]
        if model=='persistence': f=b[y-1]
        elif model=='trailing3': f=st.mean([b[t] for t in range(y-3,y)])
        else:
            ch=[b[t]-b[t-1] for t in range(2018,y)]
            f=b[y-1]+st.mean(ch)
        forecasts.append((y, f, b[y], b[y]-f, abs(b[y]-f)))
        errs.append(abs(b[y]-f))
    print(model, 'mae=', round(st.mean(errs),3), 'rows=', [(y, round(f,3), round(a,3), round(e,3)) for y,f,a,err,e in forecasts])
PY"

from urllib.request import urlopen
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
url='https://www.govinfo.gov/bulkdata/BILLSTATUS/119/hr/BILLSTATUS-119hr8800.xml'
raw=urlopen(url, timeout=30).read()
print('url=', url)
print('bytes=', len(raw))
root=ET.fromstring(raw)
def first(path):
    el=root.find(path)
    return (el.text or '').strip() if el is not None else ''
print('number=', first('./bill/number'))
print('type=', first('./bill/type'))
print('congress=', first('./bill/congress'))
print('introducedDate=', first('./bill/introducedDate'))
print('updateDate=', first('./bill/updateDate'))
print('title=', first('./bill/titles/item/title'))
print('policyArea=', first('./bill/policyArea/name'))
latest = root.findall('./bill/actions/item')[-1]
for child in latest:
    if child.tag in {'actionDate','text','type'}:
        print('latest_'+child.tag+'=', (child.text or '').strip())
# Print actions with enacted/public law if any
matches=[]
for item in root.findall('./bill/actions/item'):
    txt=' '.join((item.findtext('text') or '').split())
    typ=item.findtext('type') or ''
    date=item.findtext('actionDate') or ''
    if any(term.lower() in (txt+' '+typ).lower() for term in ['became public law','public law','presented to president','signed by president','reported']):
        matches.append((date, typ, txt[:500]))
print('selected_actions=')
for row in matches[:20]:
    print(row)
